title: L0-04 — THE DECISION REGISTER
summary: Establishes L0's unified decision register (REG-001..REG-060) with canonical id space, state tracking, and priority bands for all open technical and architectural decisions.
notes: ADR type via manifest override. Procedural meta-ADR establishing L0's decision-making infrastructure and register authority. Contains many internal decision records (REG entries) in various states (Closed, Open, etc.). No explicit 'Status: Accepted' field on document itself; marked not-locked pending decision finalization.
